keywords: Criminal appeal – Murder – Death sentence – Sole eyewitness a child aged approximately 3½ years at time of incident – Accused known to child – Immediate identification to mother and investigating officer – Police failure to record child’s statement – Section 110(1) – Whether omission fatal to prosecution – Child later giving evidence at Magisterial and non-summary inquiries – Cross-examination without contradiction – Testimonial trustworthiness – Alleged motive to falsely implicate due to land dispute rejected – No material prejudice – Conviction and sentence affirmed – Appeal dismissed. S. Devika de L. Tennekoon J. agreed.
